env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos build ./...
logos run ./main
stdout '^mid-struct struct$'
stdout '^mid-int other$'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/fwshadow

go 1.27

-- w/leaf/leaf.lgo --
package leaf

import "comptime"

func Describe[T any]() string {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return "struct"
	} else {
		return "other"
	}
}

-- w/mid/mid.lgo --
package mid

import (
	"comptime"

	"example.com/fwshadow/leaf"
)

type Choice int

func WrapAlias[T any]() string {
	type Choice = struct{}
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return leaf.Describe[Choice]()
	} else {
		return leaf.Describe[Choice]()
	}
}

func WrapNamed[T any]() string {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return leaf.Describe[Choice]()
	} else {
		return leaf.Describe[Choice]()
	}
}

-- w/main/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/fwshadow/mid"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println("mid-struct", mid.WrapAlias[int]())
	fmt.Println("mid-int", mid.WrapNamed[int]())
}
